categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to avoid throwing destructors and properly handle buffered stream flush failures.
categories.rationale: Fixes a crash caused by throwing destructors in `BufferedWriter`. Because `BufferedWriter`'s destructor was implicitly non-throwing, unflushed write failures (such as running out of disk space) threw `std::ios_base::failure` and invoked `std::terminate`, preventing clean shutdown.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Updates block and undo data writing logic in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to explicitly flush buffers and trigger a graceful fatal shutdown on write failure.
categories.rationale: Prevents abrupt `std::terminate` crashes during block and undo disk writes when the disk fills up. Explicitly catching and logging buffered write errors in `blockstorage.cpp` ensures clean shutdown sequencing and diagnostic logs rather than an unhandled termination.
